Author: Sharad Kumar Sharma
Bench: Sharad Kumar Sharma
 Office Notes,

Sl. proceedings or
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  C482 No. 1038 of 2023  Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. P.C. Petshali, Advocate, for the applicants.
Mr. T.C. Agarwal, Deputy A.G., for the State of Uttarakhand.
Mrs. Manju Bahuguna, Advocate, for respondent No.2.

The argument of the learned counsel for the applicants is, that upon culmination of the investigation into the set of allegations levelled in the FIR, in the chargesheet thus submitted, being Chargesheet No. 66 of 2023 dated 19th February, 2023, the offence under Section 376 of the IPC only shown to have been made out as against one Mr. Lallan Kumar.

But so far as the present applicants are concerned, as against them, there is no offence under Section 376 of the IPC, which has been shown to have been made out in the chargesheet, as they have been wrongly directed to be summoned for the offence under Section 3 (1) (r) of the S.C. & S.T. Act.

But on the contrary, in the summoning order thus issued by the District and Sessions Judge, Udham Singh Nagar, in Special Sessions Trial No. 454 of 2023, State Vs. Lallan Kumar and six others, the cognizance has been taken against the present applicants too for the offence under Section 376 of the IPC.
